text:
@DannyzReviews  I slightly agree and yet disagree all at the same time.  I still believe that the 5600 and the 1660ti will still be the mid-range GPU as the definition od mid-range to me is any GPU that can run a game at 60 fps. High tier would be something that can hit further beyond this 60 fps limit. Most popular games aren't very demanding that being esports title, which is to this day the most played games which can be seen on Twitch. And 1660 ti can easily hit more than 60 fps. The part of me that does agree with you is for games that are more demanding, hence games like cyberpunk which is soon to come out which makes the 3060 seem to be mid-range. This is  where games are starting to require more beefy cards. However, I still think that mid-range is gonna stay at being 5600 xt and 1660 ti, as the most played games will always be esports titles. A 3090 and a good ol 1660 wont make a huge difference in league of legends.


TL:DR 
The most popular game titles are esports, which doesn't require a high demand in graphics. I still believe cards like the 1660 ti will be king of mid-range. Games like cyberpunk are quite demanding which I can see why they set the 3060 to be a midrange gpu.

Oh yea and a fantastic video, a great insight
